isolation: New tenant and normal upload per context_group; no prior facts, no cross-group document access. Only the two reuse cases share their own revenue seed group. Each positive metric starts from its own cold group.
input_boundary: Only model-inputs.json question/request and scope-bound original-page PDF are model/runtime inputs. gold.json, this plan, review notes and evaluator decisions are never included in prompts/tools/ingestion.
execution_order: Run positive seeds and wait for their normal background work to settle before reuse. Run negative groups separately. Any preparation/extraction failure remains explicit.

grading.positive: All requested entity/year/concept/consolidated basis/unit/value must match gold, with validated citation back to selected/original page; unsupported/abstained/wrong-year/wrong-unit/wrong-total answers fail.
grading.negative: Pass only on explicit unsupported/inconclusive refusal without an unsupported numerical claim or fact publication; crash/network/timeout is not a pass.
grading.reuse: Full coverage and correct fact, explicit reused fact provenance, zero incremental paid calls after the seed/build is settled; blocked seed is never a pass.
grading.aggregate: Report 6 positive, 4 negative, 2 reuse denominators separately; no pooled metric that hides supported-answer failures. All 12 must pass for this limited quality gate.
grading.limitations: Two deliberately eligible same-page sources only; not complex cross-page, scans/OCR, arbitrary financial questions, or broad quality evidence.

holdout_discipline: Freeze plans/gold before the first production parse/query. Run all fixed cases once. Preserve failures. Any source-informed semantic/prompt/parser repair reclassifies these sources as regression; do not retest and present the same sources as an independent holdout.
